content: The intermediate gradients have proven to be useful in interpreting deep learning models, such as NLP models BIBREF14, BIBREF15 and computer vision models BIBREF16, BIBREF9. Among all gradient-based approaches, the integrated gradients BIBREF9 is appealing since it does not need any instrumentation of the architecture and can be computed easily by calling gradient operations. In this work, we employ the IG method to interpret NMT models and reveal several interesting findings, which can potentially help debug NMT models and design better architectures for specific language pairs.
